Hi Alex —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear attachments. To activate Stratiform in our procurement system and route a PO we need the following final items from your side:

- Signed DPA (we can send our DPA template if you prefer).
- Latest SOC 2 report (or a read-only link) and the report date/version.
- Complete subprocessor list with hosting regions (the CSV you sent is a good start; include any new vendors in the last 12 months).
- Legal entity name + Tax ID and remittance address (for the PO).
- Point of contact for billing and acceptance of electronic PO (name + email).

Operational notes:
- We prefer DocuSign for agreement e-signature; if you can accept, we'll initiate the envelope using your primary contact.
- For speed, if you approve our DPA template, we can pre-fill and include it in the envelope; otherwise please redline the attached DPA and return.
- Once the DPA is executed and SOC2 link received, procurement will create a PO (usually within 48 business hours) and route to the billing contact.

Could you send the SOC2 read link and the final tax details by EOD Tuesday (2026-05-25)? If not, please give an ETA. I'll loop in Karthik (procurement lead) and Marissa (legal intake) to support any follow-ups.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
